context.problem_statement: Evaluate the performance of a binary disease classifier using the provided dataset of predicted probabilities and true labels. Compute the ROC curve, report the AUC score, find the optimal classification threshold using Youden's J statistic (maximizing sensitivity + specificity - 1), and report sensitivity and specificity at that threshold. Also compute precision, recall, and F1 score at the optimal threshold.
context.expert_knowledge: Use sklearn.metrics: roc_curve, auc, classification_report. AUC ranges from 0.5 (random) to 1.0 (perfect). Youden's J = sensitivity + specificity - 1; optimal threshold maximizes this. Sensitivity = TP/(TP+FN), Specificity = TN/(TN+FP). AUC > 0.8 is generally considered good for clinical classifiers.
